parts.text: In this experiment, you will determine the magnification produced by a converging lens. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 1.1. The distance u between the illuminated triangle and the lens has been set for you. Do not change this distance. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Carefully measure u and record the value. u = ............................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Place the screen near the lens. Move the screen away from the lens until a sharp image of the triangle is seen on the screen.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Carefully measure d , the distance between the illuminated triangle and the screen, and record the value. d = ............................................

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate a value m for the magnification, using your answers to (a)(i) and (a)(iii) , and the equation m = d – u –––– u . m = ............................................ [2]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) Measure h o , the height of the illuminated triangle, and record the value. h o = ............................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Measure h i , the height of the sharp image on the screen, and record the value. h i = ............................................

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate M , another value for the magnification, using your answers to (b)(i) and (b)(ii) , and the equation M = h i –– h o . M = ............................................ [2]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (d) (i) In the space below, sketch the sharp image seen on the screen.
